headline: If adopted, this House resolution would have censured and condemned Representative Adam Schiff of California for certain misleading conduct, but the House did not adopt it.
what_it_does: The resolution would have formally censured and condemned Representative Adam Schiff of California. According to the official summary, the censure was based on certain misleading conduct by him. The House voted on October 21, 2019 to table the measure or refer it to committee, so it was not adopted.

who_it_affects.how: He would have been formally censured and condemned by the House for the conduct described in the resolution.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the House of Representatives
who_it_affects.how: They would have voted on a formal rebuke of a fellow member, which the House instead set aside.
